reviews.review_msg: Instructor is not good and lectures are boring. Course content is not useful at all.

This course felt unnecessary. Attendance was mandatory, and the Canvas check-in window was too short. Even if students were in class, missing the online check-in still counted. I did not feel respected and did not learn anything. Since students are paying tuition for this required course, I expected it to be more engaging and meaningful.

Class began at 10:30, and he came at 10:33. With a quick and unclear mumble,  he unlock the attendance and set it less than two minutes and keep mumbling. He didn't accept any feedback of the attendance quiz, he's totally a sb

The class content feels incredibly unneeded. I do not know if it is the prof's fault but the course is very uninteresting. He tries to trick the class with frequent attendances which feel cheap and do not respect my independence or time as an adult.
professor is unfair and violates the university code of ethics and fairness

Professor is unfair, pretty sure it violates SFU ethical regulations. Professor took attendance at the start of class. Then, he cancelled it and retook attendance when everyone was on break. He then selectively told people about the new one.When confronted, he threatened that future ones would only have 30 seconds to complete.

Attendance is taken unfairly. Professor decided he was unhappy with the class, so he cancelled the first attendance and secretly opened a second one when everyone was on break. When confronted, he threatened that future attendances would have a 30 second window to complete.
